verdict.rationale: Railway's own docs say you connect an existing repo and it handles auto-config with "no new tools to learn." Configuration can stay off YAML, and every pull request gets its own preview, so the core Git workflow is covered. The CLI is offered as an option rather than a requirement. Cloud agents can be driven from standard tools like Codex Desktop over SSH or Claude Desktop, but explicit evidence for existing CI pipelines and broad framework compatibility is absent. Missing for 10: documented integration with existing CI systems (e.g., GitHub Actions), explicit framework/buildpack compatibility details, evidence that local editor workflows need no Railway-specific tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
